title: SAVOY BARBECUE — photo spread, Denison Herald, March 14, 1954
text:
age 3—THE DENISON HERALD—Sunday, March 14, 1954

[Photograph top left: Two men at a barbecue pit. One man loads a tray.]
[Photograph top right: Three women at a serving table with cakes and food.]

SAVOY BARBECUE—Glenn McKinney loads up the tray of Thomas Blakey with a portion of the 375-pounds of barbecue from the portable pit outside the Savoy Cafeteria. Cakes were plentiful, too. Harry Bomar aids Mrs. Pierce Bibby and Mrs. Mib Waldrum in slicing and serving.
(Staff photos by John Clift)

[Photograph bottom: Three people, two men and a woman, exchanging coffee pots.]

THE COFFEE WAS FREE—Mrs. Harold Davis, general food chairman at the Savoy barbecue, hands out coffee pots to Charlie Price and Earl Blakey, left to right, Friday night.
notes: Photo spread showing community barbecue event, likely a fundraiser or community rally related to the 1954 Savoy fire. The page number at top is partially cut off ('age 3').
